description: Utility class providing methods to extract and format detailed information from Android's EditorInfo objects, including input type, IME options, and caps mode, primarily for debugging or logging purposes.

classes.name: EditorInfoUtil
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for dumping and formatting details of EditorInfo objects in Android.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the editorInfo object, or 'null' if editorInfo is null.

methods.name: dump (overload)
methods.description: Appends detailed information about the editorInfo object to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpInputType
methods.description: Appends a descriptive string of the inputType flags and class to the StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpImeOptions
methods.description: Appends a descriptive string of the imeOptions flags and action to the StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpCapsMode
methods.description: Appends a descriptive string of the caps mode flags to the StringBuilder.
